description: This is a shell script for testing and managing a Git to Perforce (git p4) integration, including user preservation, permissions, and commit handling.

methods.name: p4_grant_admin
methods.description: Grants admin rights to a specified user in Perforce.

methods.name: p4_check_commit_author
methods.description: Checks if the latest change for a file was made by a specific user in Perforce.

methods.name: make_change_by_user
methods.description: Creates a git commit with specified author details and modifies a file.
